html:
Added

  • "What's new" right in the update window. When an update is offered, the popup now lists the changes in the version you're about to get — so you know what you're updating to before you click. It shows only that one version's changes, not the whole history.

Changed

  • The update window now opens in the center of the screen instead of wherever the browser happened to put it.

Both are in the update window itself, so no re-drag needed — you'll see them on your next update.
